tracks.title: Loa Bến Xe Số Mười Hai
tracks.subject: Chị Hương, the loudspeaker announcer at a coach station, sings out each departure in the same cadence; coach driver Tài has rolled out on her last word for three years, and the day she swaps in a new line he stalls the engine on the platform, and the whole station hears her laugh.
